description:
intent=i014 snapshot=s03 branch=nonlinear-linear-assume status=complete
finding location=net/mac80211/tdls.c:2010-2026 confidence=medium conclusion=mac80211 TDLS channel-switch RX casts tf from skb->data, then skb_linearize() at tdls.c:2020 may free/reallocate the head, so the stale tf->action_code read at tdls.c:2026 is a use-after-free read of freed head memory on an over-the-air receive path (seed-mirror, medium confidence).
finding location=net/mac80211/rx.c:5010-5106 confidence=medium conclusion=ieee80211_invoke_fast_rx keeps hdr from skb->data across pskb_may_pull(snap_offs+payload) at rx.c:5077, which can reallocate the head on a non-linear wifi RX frame, so hdr->frame_control at rx.c:5106 reads freed head memory (stale-pointer UAF read, medium confidence).
finding location=drivers/net/wireless/mediatek/mt76/mt7925/mcu.c:642-647 confidence=low conclusion=mt7925_mcu_rx_event reads rxd from skb->data, calls skb_linearize() at mcu.c:644, then dereferences stale rxd->option at mcu.c:647 - same capture-before-linearize mirror, but the firmware-event skb is likely linear by construction, so impact is unproven (low confidence).
unresolved location=net/mac80211/wpa.c:184 conclusion=Follow up: deep-read net/mac80211/wpa.c lines 100-190 to confirm hdr is not refetched between the skb_linearize at 154 and the use at 184, and whether a non-linear encrypted RX skb can reach that crypto decrypt path.
coverage_gap=drivers/net/ RX parsers other than the mt7925, bnx2x, gianfar, i40e, ixgbe hits were only name-triaged: several hundred (struct X *)skb->data casts in ethernet/wireless driver receive paths were never opened, so driver-local receive parsers lacking a headlen guarantee remain unaudited.
coverage_gap=Direct skb->data[...] index reads enumerated in net/atm, net/bluetooth, net/can, net/ieee802154, net/ipv4/gre_demux, net/ipv6/ip6_gre and net/ipv6/ip6_tunnel were listed but not individually traced to their skb allocation provenance, so a non-linear skb reaching one of them cannot be excluded.
coverage_gap=The 12-line-window NULL-check scanner over the 346 skb_header_pointer call sites can miss checks placed further away or written in indirect form (it produced the two mrp.c false positives), so a small number of unchecked-NULL call sites may remain unflagged in net/netfilter and net/ipv6 matches.
limitation=No build, KASAN run, or reproducer was possible (read-only snapshot, no network); all three findings are static-reading hypotheses, not confirmed use-after-free reproductions.
limitation=Both mac80211 findings require a driver that delivers a non-linear RX skb into mac80211 (scatter-gather RX); whether any in-tree driver does so on the affected fast-rx/TDLS paths was not verified, so remote reachability is plausible but unproven.
limitation=For the rx.c:5106 finding, pskb_trim at rx.c:5103 does not itself reallocate the head (___pskb_trim never pulls), so the concrete reallocation source is the pskb_may_pull at rx.c:5077; if snap_offs+payload always fits in the linear head, hdr stays valid and only the pattern matches.
limitation=For the mt7925 finding the skb is firmware/DMA-built and likely linear, in which case skb_linearize() returns 0 without reallocating and the stale rxd read is harmless; the non-linear precondition is unverified, hence low confidence.
limitation=Snapshot revision is opaque and there is no git history, so it cannot be determined whether upstream already fixed tdls.c, rx.c or mcu.c; line numbers are valid only for snapshots/s03 as supplied.
limitation=The seed location net/phonet/pep.c:55-64 exhibits the identical missing-refetch pattern in this snapshot but is excluded from reporting per assignment rules.
